landing.heroSubtitle: Bridging timeless Ayurvedic clinical wisdom with modern intelligent intake, standardized Ashtavidha Pariksha, and frictionless multilingual digital care workflows.
landing.problemTitle: The Challenge in Modern Ayurvedic OPDs
landing.problemDesc: Traditional Ayurvedic case-taking is deeply individualized and comprehensive, requiring extensive inquiry into Ahara, Vihara, Prakriti, Agni, and Srotas. High OPD volumes often restrict intake time and lack standardized multilingual digital records.
landing.solutionDesc: AYURAI streamlines pre-consultation anamnesis with multilingual patient guidance, intelligent preliminary symptom mapping, and structured Ashtavidha Pariksha summaries for doctors.
landing.patientWorkflowDesc: Seamless 4-step onboarding: Multilingual registration, AI-guided questionnaire, Prakriti self-check, and live queue tracking on phone or kiosk.
landing.doctorWorkflowDesc: Instant 360° patient dossier, Dosha-Agni-Dhatu differential breakdown, and swift Classical formulation prescription builder.
landing.multilingualDesc: Available in 6 Indian languages so patients can communicate their symptoms naturally in their mother tongue.
landing.responsibleAiDesc: AYURAI acts strictly as a clinical decision support assistant. It standardizes intake data and generates differential suggestions while keeping final clinical authority solely with the qualified Ayurvedic practitioner.
landing.disclaimer: Ayurvedic Medical Disclaimer: AI suggestions are assistive tools for clinical workflow support and do not replace professional medical diagnosis by a registered BAMS/MD Ayurvedic physician.
